eeiParameters.capacity_definition: primary precomputed Total_per_floor after GIULU filtering

localMethod: Paired finite model surfaces, equal-area 5 m triangles; paper EEI normalization; no imputation or clamping
method: Paper national EEI parameters and paired, valid, positive-capacity layers; face-count-weighted building means; OLS against log1p(mean nine-category CBG travel time); residual midpoint ranks over the whole metro.
